findings.detail: Self-improvement UI components directly import and invoke selfDevelopment/improvement services instead of exclusively using the typed CORE UI gateway.
typedImprovementUiGatewayService coexists with direct service calls and multiple lifecycle entry services, so CORE is not the exclusive authority for every self-improvement UI action.
UI can call developmentReviewLifecycleService.start/create directly, which can create review lifecycle state without a clearly demonstrated preceding CORE task/re-evaluation boundary.

Council review, generated tests, dead-code scan, prompt-to-patch, snapshot rollback and code search are exposed as direct tool actions. Some may be read-only or bounded, but their receipts are not uniformly proven to share one CORE-owned task/run identity.
PromotionGateSubView.tsx is marked ORPHAN in the complete inventory, so the visible promotion gate may not be part of the active UI path.
The P97 inventory reports 22 ORPHAN and 9 AVAILABLE_EXPORT_ONLY files in selfDevelopment, indicating implemented capability that is not proven to participate in the canonical production loop.

autonomousSelfImprovementLoopService is initialized by domainIntegrationBootstrapService, persists state, creates CORE tasks, uses taskBlackboardService, and submits/resumes through coreTaskIngressService. This is not merely a facade.
Design and verification scripts preserve REVIEW_ZIP and HUMAN_ONLY formal adoption boundaries.

requiredRepairs: Make typedImprovementUiGatewayService the exclusive write/action gateway for self-improvement UI.
Add gateway methods for review lifecycle, code search, council review, generated tests, dead-code scan, prompt-to-patch and rollback, each requiring CORE task/run identity and receipt.
Convert direct UI imports to gateway calls; retain direct domain imports only inside CORE/domain integration layers.
Require developmentReviewLifecycleService.start to validate a CORE-owned taskId/runId and candidate lineage.
Unify all candidate/review/promotion actions under the same taskBlackboard and improvementIntakeRouter identity.
Connect or formally retire PromotionGateSubView and audit all 31 non-USED selfDevelopment files.
Add a static gate that fails build when self_improvement UI imports miki selfDevelopment/improvement service implementations directly.
